pages.name: Lion's Park, Belleville
pages.currentRecord: Belleville's current listing identifies Lion's Park at 70 Station Street as a landscaped park with floral gardens, wedding-photo use, and trail access; it does not identify Lion's Park as the City's off-leash facility. pages.currentRecord: Ottawa's current dogs-in-parks record identifies Don Boudria Park at 655 Décoeur Drive as an accessible community park that is not designated for off-leash use; dogs must remain on leash.

improvementQueue.name: Ajax Waterfront Park

The current Town leash-free list and dog-park GIS do not designate Ajax Waterfront itself as leash-free; dogs must remain leashed on and within three metres of multi-use and off-road trails.
